subject: Gleason School Performance of Annie
overview: Second and third-grade students at Gleason School presented a musical performance of Annie. Following the play, staff recognized the cast groups and parent volunteers.

items.title: Student Performance of Annie
items.summary: Second and third-grade students acted out scenes and sang musical numbers from Annie.

items.title: Curtain Call and Acknowledgments
items.summary: Organizers called up student cast groups for applause and presented flowers to parent volunteers.
